<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Receive Device">77a7642ec380e210d6d19883e401313a</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:55aae8eec380e210d6d19883e40131b2</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>false</isolate_script><messages/><name>Add New Device</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below
    if (newValue == 'true') {
        g_form.setVisible('model', true);
        g_form.setMandatory('model', true);

        g_form.setVisible('serial_number', true);
        g_form.setMandatory('serial_number', true);

        g_form.setVisible('device', false);
        g_form.clearValue('device');
    }
	else{
        g_form.setVisible('model', false);
        g_form.setMandatory('model', false);

        g_form.setVisible('serial_number', false);
        g_form.setMandatory('serial_number', false);

        g_form.setVisible('device', true);
        g_form.clearValue('device');
	}
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Thomas.Flanagan@pivotts.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-05 21:28:26</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>f3a4556ac344e210d6d19883e4013112</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Add New Device</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Buffalo Repairs" source="x_pits_buffalo_r_0">5ed22426c380e210d6d19883e4013137</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Buffalo Repairs">5ed22426c380e210d6d19883e4013137</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_f3a4556ac344e210d6d19883e4013112</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Thomas.Flanagan@pivotts.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-05 22:33:26</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><u_variable_display_name>add_new_device</u_variable_display_name><u_variable_reference display_value="Add New Device">55aae8eec380e210d6d19883e40131b2</u_variable_reference><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
